title: The Pieri Rule at Infinity
summary: We study the structure of tensor products of $\mathfrak{gl}(\infty) = \varinjlim \mathfrak{gl}(n)$-modules $\mathbf L(\mathbf λ) \otimes \mathbf F$ where $\mathbf L(\mathbf λ)$ is a simple integrable highest weight module and $\mathbf F$ is a simple integrable weight multiplicity-free module. Both $\mathbf L(\mathbf λ)$ and $\mathbf F$ are infinite dimensional, in particular $\mathbf F$ can be a Fock module.
